title: Eurostat SDG 11.52: premature deaths due to PM2.5 exposure, Italy (annual)
summary: Annual national series from Eurostat (dataset sdg_11_52, source ESTAT) giving premature deaths attributable to fine particulate matter (PM2.5) for Italy only, in two units (number and rate). The JSON-stat response has 36 cells (18 years x 2 units) with no missing values, covering 2005 to 2023 with 2006 absent from the time dimension. It is national, yearly context and cannot support hourly, district or clinic-level modelling.

access.request_process: Eurostat dissemination API (JSON-stat 2.0), HTTP 200, no key needed for this request. Eurostat is not on the external register as a public API; the register's open-data policy covers statistics offices for prototyping, benchmarking and context only, subject to licence read at source.

quality_notes: Temporal coverage does not match the production window (2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31): the series ends in 2023.

Year 2006 is absent from the time dimension (2005, 2007, ...); gap not explained in the response.
Annual national estimate only: cannot provide the hourly or daily grain required by N1-N4; the need is N6 (annual context) only.
Unit dimension has two values (NR number, RT rate); a downstream user must filter on unit to avoid mixing them.
No licence, owner or refresh cadence stated in the response; the 'updated' timestamp is the only date metadata.
The candidate URL includes a trailing '&' and lang=EN; the canonical ref was normalised by inspect_dataset_link.

unit has two values: NR (Number) and RT (Rate), so the value set mixes counts and rates.
